name: Tuck
author: twodxme
description: Tuck the bar widgets you rarely need behind a divider; click, hotkey, or auto-hide

barWidget.description: Divider that collapses and expands the widgets dropped into it

schema.label: Open on
schema.description: Click the arrow to open and close, or open while the pointer is over it and close shortly after it leaves.

schema.label: Tuck away automatically
schema.description: Click mode: close again after autoHideSeconds. Waits while the pointer is over it, while a widget is dragged, and while a tucked widget's panel is open.

schema.label: Start open
schema.description: Show tucked widgets when the shell starts.

schema.label: Open on every monitor
schema.description: A click opens and closes the bar on all screens together. The IPC toggle always does.

schema.label: Opens toward
schema.description: auto opens away from the section's fixed edge; start is left (up on a vertical bar), end is right (down).

schema.label: Show count
schema.description: Number of tucked widgets beside the arrow while closed (horizontal bars).

schema.label: Hide when empty
schema.description: No arrow while nothing is tucked; it reappears while a widget is dragged.

schema.label: Animate
schema.description: Slide open and closed. Omarchy's global animation switch also turns it off.
